insight.text: Insight: Operating loss of $23.6 million increased $10.7 million and adjusted operating loss of $21.3 million increased $10.9 million, both as compared to the prior year period, primarily due to higher selling, general and administrative expenses and direct operating expenses. [earnings_release.txt, line 26]

Overview.text: Revenues for the quarter were $14.1 million, a $0.4 million increase from the prior year period.

Market Positioning and Growth Outlook.text: The increase in operating loss and higher selling, general and administrative expenses indicate a weakening competitive position.
